description: Source code implementing memory management for disjoint storage groups in PyTorch's native runtime, including classes and functions for planning storage allocations based on allocation specs and lifetimes.

classes.name: StorageGroup
classes.description: Represents a collection of allocation specs sharing backing storage, managing size, lifetime, and free status.

methods.name: DisjointStorageGroupsPlanner
methods.description: Plans storage allocation for a set of allocation specs, optimizing for disjoint storage groups based on their lifetimes and sizes.
